dimensions.label: Business & technology fit
dimensions.level_2: Explicit cloud software / SaaS or digital service that handles customer data
dimensions.level_1: Software or digital product, but unclear whether it is SaaS or handles customer data

dimensions.label: Customer trust exposure
dimensions.level_2: Enterprise plan/offering, named enterprise customers, or regulated customer segments (finance, health, government)
dimensions.level_1: Sells to businesses (B2B) but no explicit enterprise or regulated signal

dimensions.label: Compliance workload
dimensions.level_2: Explicit audit, framework (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI), certification in progress, or ongoing controls
dimensions.level_1: Handles sensitive data or mentions security/privacy in general terms, without a named framework

dimensions.label: Reason to engage now
dimensions.level_2: Relevant hiring (security/GRC/compliance), audit or deadline dated within the last 6 months
dimensions.level_1: Dated expansion signal within 12 months (funding round, new market, enterprise launch)

dimensions.label: Delivery complexity
dimensions.level_2: Multiple frameworks, environments, regions or products
dimensions.level_1: One framework or one product with several customer segments
